chapter_title_en: The Three Hundred and Sixty-Five Divine Acupoints
chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen's 365 Acupoints Manifest Deities and Babra Flees
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen battles the Otherworld Ancestral God Babra in a desperate clash. After near defeat, his 365 divinized acupoints manifest a deity and 364 phantoms, terrifying Babra into flight.
og_title: The Three Hundred Sixty-Five Deities: Xiao Chen's Acupoint Awakening
og_description: In a fierce battle against the remnant soul of an Ancestral God, Xiao Chen's full acupoint divinization triggers the manifestation of three hundred sixty-five shadow deities, forcing his enemy to flee.
twitter_description: Overwhelmed by Babra, Xiao Chen's Profound Art awakens fully—365 acupoints erupt with light, conjuring a legion of gods that terrify the Ancestral God into retreat.
